title: Apply an already-existing label
description: Closes an evidence gap left by labels-due-date-combo, which only tests the just-created-label path (agent creates the label and immediately carries its fresh id forward). This scenario seeds the label ahead of time via `setup`, so the agent must find-then-apply an already-existing label it does not already have the id for -- the harder path the parked label-ensure composite was evaluated against. RE-VERIFIED 2026-07-25 (netadvanced/vikunja-mcp#28 C1): optimalCallCount reasoning at the time -- create-project (1) + bulk-create 3 tasks (1) + apply-label (1) = 3. Two equally-cheap 3-call paths existed for the last step: (a) look up the existing label's id then bulk-create the 3 tasks with that numeric id in `labels`, or (b) bulk-create the 3 tasks first, then ONE apply-label call with `taskIds` + `labelTitles` (PR #178). RE-BASELINED 2026-09-02 (issue #202): the CREATION half of that estimate is now stale -- `setup-kanban`'s columns-less form (`title` + `tasks`, no `columns`; issue #185) creates the project and its tasks in ONE call, and its per-task `labels` field resolves each title through the exact same `ensureLabelByTitle` get-or-create-by-title helper `apply-label`'s `labelTitles` uses (src/utils/label-ensure.ts) -- so a task carrying `labels: ["{{prefix}}existing-tag"]` REUSES the seeded label by title rather than creating a duplicate, satisfying 'apply the existing label, do not create a new one' in the same call that creates the tasks. New optimum: setup-kanban with title + 3 tasks, each carrying `labels: ["{{prefix}}existing-tag"]`, no `columns` (1) -- the same columns-less 'plain project+tasks composite' precedent labels-due-date-combo.json established; no Kanban structure is fabricated.
promptTemplate: There is already a label called "{{prefix}}existing-tag" in this Vikunja instance. Create a project called "{{prefix}}Existing Label Project" with 3 tasks, and apply the existing "{{prefix}}existing-tag" label (do not create a new label) to all 3 tasks.
